# libghostty-vt (vendored, prebuilt)

The static libghostty-vt library and its C headers, built from a pinned ghostty commit so
that building code-foundry needs only Go and the Xcode Command Line Tools: no zig, no
ghostty checkout, and no network access to ghostty's zig dependencies.

```
lib/libghostty-vt.a   static library, darwin-arm64 only, debug info stripped (strip -S)
include/ghostty/      C headers, copied verbatim from the build
MANIFEST              ghostty commit, Go bindings version, zig version, build mode, sha256
share/pkgconfig/      generated by `make ghostty-vt` with this checkout's absolute path (gitignored)
```

`make ghostty-vt` (a dependency of `build`, `check`, and `package`) checks the library's
sha256 and the go.mod version of `go.mitchellh.com/libghostty` against MANIFEST, then writes
`share/pkgconfig/libghostty-vt-static.pc`, which the Go bindings find through
`PKG_CONFIG_PATH`.

## Regenerating

Bump `go.mitchellh.com/libghostty` in go.mod and `GHOSTTY_COMMIT` in
`scripts/ghostty-vt.sh` together, then run

```sh
make ghostty-vt-rebuild   # downloads zig + ghostty into third_party/build/, rewrites this dir
make check
```

and commit the changed files here. See `docs/notes/vendored-libghostty-vt.md`.
